caption: The drawing features a single wooden rocking chair positioned centrally against a plain, light beige background. The chair is depicted in a three-quarter view, showing its left side more prominently. It has a curved top rail, slender vertical spindles forming the backrest, and curved armrests supported by additional vertical spindles. The seat is slightly scooped, and the legs are connected by horizontal stretchers, with the bottoms attached to two curved rockers. The chair is colored in shades of brown, ranging from dark brown on the top rail and rockers to lighter brown on the armrests, seat, and spindles. The entire drawing is highly detailed, depicting the grain and shadows of the wood, while the background remains uniformly empty with no additional objects or patterns.
title: Rocking Chair
